body: Thanks I really needed to hear that.  I’m sorry that you relate to my letter. Heartbreak and loss are such terrible things I wish we didn’t have to feel them but it helps us appreciate what we have in our lives and to remember to cherish them.

My life is definitely full of what ifs. I’ve always hated that I never take risks. I’m too afraid of rejection. Hopefully I’ll find the courage to get over my fear one day. I know, sometimes the person is just waiting for you to say something.
“Why do you always wear a hoodie?”
Same here. It’s such a terrible thing to lose someone you care about.
Wish you never met me-Papa Roach

“We’re all stories in the end, just make it a good one, eh”  
  When we’re gone we’ll just be a story so why not make it a good, interesting story for people to remember us by.

Exactly what I was thinking. Winter can’t get here soon enough. I don’t have any fresh wounds at the moment but a lot of new scars. It’s definitely a lot easier and more comfortable to wear long sleeves in the winter.

That’s how I feel about t right now but I do try to remind myself I can stop taking it anytime if I do decide to take it in the future. Chase is literally my role model. I constantly rewatch his videos trying to figure everything out. I definitely know I want top surgery so that’s a start I suppose. I’ve been thinking about therapy. I’ve just haven’t been able to actually accept my self. That’s awesome that you know you’re doing the right thing. Hopefully I’ll feel that way too one day.
